description: Build trust_synthesiser_v2_pi_audit.py: a quality-pass diagnostic that reads trust_synthesiser_v2.py from disk and verifies (1) it reads mcp_signal_scores where dimension='injection_resilience', (2) applies weight 1.6, (3) applies threshold 0.80 for that dimension, (4) includes the injection_resilience score in the composite calculation. Phase 8 harness components are built; the spec says trust_synthesiser_v2 may already be correct but needs verification. The audit file outputs: {conforms: bool, findings: list of strings}. This is audit-only; does NOT modify trust_synthesiser_v2.py. Exits 0 on success. If conforms=True and findings=[], queue nothing. If conforms=False, queue a companion module that patches the gap rather than rewriting the protected file.
